body: Fixes #9 and more specifically (1) and (2). Left the client ID issue alone since it seemed out of scope

commits.messageBody:
Starting the connect backoff on connection resets caused enough COMMIT
messages to be lost to trigger a view change, even though the primary
was healthy. Spurious view changes don't affect correctness but reduce
availability as requests can't be served outside of normal operation.
This fix only starts the backoff when a connect() fails and not when a
connection resets (or any other write error occurs).
commits.messageHeadline: Skip connect() backoff when a live connection is dropped
Emit Event::Disconnect when a client terminates abruptly

title: Fix connection-lifecycles bugs in kvstore example
